messages:
nina: FYI Prospect Helix asked for a 3-month dedicated commit: 5x A100 baseline + optional H100 burst for a single 10-day eval window. They want: (1) 30% credit month1, (2) convert unused H100 hours to credit if they sign 12mo, (3) waive surge multiplier during eval. Need deal-desk + finance.
omar: Quick context 10-day H100 window is to validate throughput. Theyre engineering-heavy and likely to expand if perf looks good.
lena: Solutions: we can gate H100 to job labels and region-lock. Recommend cap on H100-hours to avoid open-ended exposure. Also require 24-48h canary.
cal: Finance: standard discount threshold is 25% before needing deal-desk. Conversion credits acceptable if non-refundable and timeboxed. For surge waiver we need to model worst-case billable spend. Please include expected GPU-hour profile.
deal-desk-bot: @channel Open a deal-desk ticket using: /deal-desk create --customer Helix --commit "5x A100 90d" --burst "up to 5x H100 for 10d" --discount "30% month1" --conversion-credit "max 200 H100-hours" --surcharge-waive yes
nina: Putting PSR and projected GPU-hours into the ticket. My suggested guardrails: conversion credit capped at 200 H100-hours; credit expires 45 days after POC unless converted into a 12-month commit. If converted, credit applies to first invoice at standard burst rate. No cash refunds.
lena: Draft terms for ticket paste:
```
- Baseline: 5x A100 reserved for 90 days.
- Burst: up to 5x H100 for a single 10-day evaluation window during POC.
- Discount: 30% credit applied to month 1 invoice for baseline commit only.
- Conversion Credit: Unused H100 hours (up to 200 H100-hours) convertible to account credit applied to the first invoice of a subsequent 12-month Dedicated commitment executed within 45 days of POC completion. No cash refunds; not transferable outside customer org unless approved in writing.
- Surge Multiplier: Waived for the 10-day evaluation window only.
- Autoscale/Canary: 24-48h canary ramp required; region-locked to eu-west-1.
- Billing: burst consumption exceeding 200 H100-hours billed at standard burst rate.
```
cal: Add clause: "If conversion occurs, credit calculation uses the standard burst rate in effect on the last day of the POC." Legal will need to vet transferability language.
omar: Helix asked for transferability to another business unit. Legal risk noted; counterproposal: transferable within parent org with prior written approval.
deal-desk-bot: @cal Confirm: discounts >25% or non-standard conversion-credit rules require Deal Desk approval + Revenue Ops sign-off. Tag @revenue-ops on submit.
cal: Confirmed. I can approve up to 28% with finance lead; full 30% requires deal-desk + rev-ops.
nina: Filing now with proposed terms and request for 30% exception. Added model family and token throughput to help compute net economics.
deal-desk-bot reaction: :white_check_mark:
lena: I'll prep the canary runbook and metrics to monitor (p95 latency, p99, GPU temp, OOMs). Coordinate with eng-run to avoid conflicts.
omar: Keeping thread for updates. Once deal-desk signs off we'll loop in legal and schedule the eval window. :thumbsup:"
